title: splat
description: Bridge-to-simulation message, sent with window.postMessage by cobeart-app/public/fluid-bridge.js to every iframe and to its own window: one message per rigid body per bridge tick (120 Hz), from the latest /viewer frame. It is that frame's rigid-body entry unchanged (same field names, units and ranges as frame.schema.json), plus 'type' and 'color'. It has no schemaVersion: it never leaves the frontend and changes together with the frame contract.

type.description: Message discriminator. Listeners ignore messages with any other type (e.g. 'cursor').

color.description: Splat colour as linear RGB, each channel in [0, 1].
